title: Fair Abstractive Summarization of Diverse Perspectives

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring the distribution alignment of male and female user perspectives in generated summaries versus source texts using N-gram and neural matching metrics (e.g., Binary Unfair Rate, Unfair Error Rate).

Evaluating the proportional representation of different political party affiliations (e.g., pro-republican, pro-democrat, neutral) in generated summaries of election-related social media posts compared to the original input distribution.

Analyzing whether generated summaries fairly represent the diverse sentiments (positive, neutral, negative) and star ratings (1 to 5) present in the source product and business reviews, ensuring critical or minority opinions are not underrepresented.

Quantifying the distribution of individual speakers' contributions in multi-party dialogue summaries (such as Supreme Court oral arguments and public debates) to ensure no participant's perspective is disproportionately omitted.
